query_specs.description: Monthly owner trend with blended, public, and hidden percentages so release leads can see whether a support issue is localized or systemic.
query_specs.sql:
select
  owner,
  substr(started_at, 1, 7) as month_bucket,
  count(*) as run_count,
  round(avg(percent), 2) as average_percent,
  round(avg(hidden_percent), 2) as average_hidden_percent,
  round(avg(json_extract(payload_json, '$.public_percent')), 2) as average_public_percent
from history_import
where owner = :owner
  and started_at >= :since
  and started_at < :until
group by owner, month_bucket
order by month_bucket desc
query_specs.title: Owner trend rollup

query_specs.description: Breakdown of ready, watch, and blocked rows by channel so a release manager can see whether one rollout path is carrying unusual operational risk.
query_specs.sql:
select
  release_channel,
  band,
  count(*) as row_count,
  round(avg(percent), 2) as average_percent
from history_import
where release_channel = :release_channel
  and started_at >= :since
group by release_channel, band
order by release_channel, band
query_specs.title: Channel band mix

query_specs.description: Rows where the public-hidden gap is large enough to require a manual read even if the total score is still above the nominal release threshold.
query_specs.sql:
select
  history_id,
  bundle_id,
  owner,
  percent,
  hidden_percent,
  json_extract(payload_json, '$.public_percent') as public_percent,
  round(json_extract(payload_json, '$.public_percent') - hidden_percent, 2) as gap
from history_import
where started_at >= :since
  and (json_extract(payload_json, '$.public_percent') - hidden_percent) >= :gap_floor
order by gap desc, started_at desc
query_specs.title: Hidden gap watchlist

query_specs.description: Slow review rows grouped with owner and release channel so the platform team can separate runtime pressure from content drift.
query_specs.sql:
select
  history_id,
  owner,
  bundle_id,
  release_channel,
  json_extract(payload_json, '$.queue_latency_ms') as queue_latency_ms,
  started_at
from history_import
where json_extract(payload_json, '$.queue_latency_ms') >= :latency_floor
order by queue_latency_ms desc, started_at desc
query_specs.title: Queue latency outliers

query_specs.description: Counts how many blocked and watch rows piled up for one owner in the recent window to support weekly staffing and blackout decisions.
query_specs.sql:
select
  owner,
  band,
  count(*) as row_count,
  round(avg(percent), 2) as average_percent,
  min(started_at) as first_seen,
  max(started_at) as last_seen
from history_import
where owner = :owner
  and started_at >= :since
group by owner, band
order by row_count desc, band
query_specs.title: Owner capacity pressure

query_specs.description: Shows the digest history for a bundle so auditors can tell whether packet or release changes coincide with scoring movement.
query_specs.sql:
select
  bundle_id,
  json_extract(payload_json, '$.artifact_digest') as artifact_digest,
  count(*) as row_count,
  min(started_at) as first_seen,
  max(started_at) as last_seen
from history_import
where bundle_id = :bundle_id
group by bundle_id, artifact_digest
order by last_seen desc
query_specs.title: Bundle digest drift

query_specs.description: Summarizes auto, owner, support, and audit review states by owner to show where human review effort is actually landing.
query_specs.sql:
select
  owner,
  json_extract(payload_json, '$.review_state') as review_state,
  count(*) as row_count,
  round(avg(percent), 2) as average_percent
from history_import
where started_at >= :since
group by owner, review_state
order by owner, review_state
query_specs.title: Review state balance

query_specs.description: Compares worker versions against score movement to help isolate operational shifts from content changes.
query_specs.sql:
select
  json_extract(payload_json, '$.worker_version') as worker_version,
  count(*) as row_count,
  round(avg(percent), 2) as average_percent,
  round(avg(hidden_percent), 2) as average_hidden_percent
from history_import
where started_at >= :since
group by worker_version
order by worker_version
query_specs.title: Worker version shift

query_specs.description: Rows that are close to ready but still blocked by policy or hidden-gap conditions. Useful when a release train is almost full and owners want to know what is one step away.
query_specs.sql:
select
  history_id,
  bundle_id,
  owner,
  percent,
  hidden_percent,
  band,
  started_at
from history_import
where owner = :owner
  and started_at >= :since
  and band in ('watch', 'blocked')
  and percent >= 80.0
order by percent desc, started_at desc
query_specs.title: Ready band holdouts

query_specs.description: Owner and bundle level averages for portfolio summaries and release briefs.
query_specs.sql:
select
  owner,
  bundle_id,
  count(*) as run_count,
  round(avg(percent), 2) as average_percent,
  round(avg(hidden_percent), 2) as average_hidden_percent
from history_import
where started_at >= :since
group by owner, bundle_id
order by owner, bundle_id
query_specs.title: Owner bundle matrix

query_specs.description: A rough inventory of rows carrying policy flags so owners can see whether review friction is a one-off or a pattern.
query_specs.sql:
select
  owner,
  case
    when payload_json like '%requires-review%' then 'requires-review'
    when payload_json like '%public-hidden-gap%' then 'public-hidden-gap'
    else 'none'
  end as flag_group,
  count(*) as row_count
from history_import
where started_at >= :since
group by owner, flag_group
order by owner, flag_group
query_specs.title: Policy flag frequency

query_specs.description: Shows how one bundle moved through channels over time. Useful for validating whether a partner release is really new or simply the latest stop in a longer path.
query_specs.sql:
select
  bundle_id,
  release_channel,
  count(*) as row_count,
  min(started_at) as first_seen,
  max(started_at) as last_seen
from history_import
where bundle_id = :bundle_id
group by bundle_id, release_channel
order by last_seen desc
query_specs.title: Bundle release channel mix

query_specs.description: Focuses on rows that landed in support review and correlates their latency with owner and bundle.
query_specs.sql:
select
  owner,
  bundle_id,
  json_extract(payload_json, '$.queue_latency_ms') as queue_latency_ms,
  started_at
from history_import
where started_at >= :since
  and json_extract(payload_json, '$.review_state') = 'support'
order by queue_latency_ms desc, started_at desc
query_specs.title: Support review latency

query_specs.description: Captures the audit-side queue so the team can separate evidence problems from general review backlog.
query_specs.sql:
select
  owner,
  bundle_id,
  json_extract(payload_json, '$.queue_latency_ms') as queue_latency_ms,
  started_at
from history_import
where started_at >= :since
  and json_extract(payload_json, '$.review_state') = 'audit'
order by queue_latency_ms desc, started_at desc
query_specs.title: Audit review latency

query_specs.description: Min/max spread for one owner over a time window. Helps explain why an average can look calm when the underlying runs are not.
query_specs.sql:
select
  owner,
  min(percent) as min_percent,
  max(percent) as max_percent,
  round(max(percent) - min(percent), 2) as spread
from history_import
where owner = :owner
  and started_at >= :since
group by owner
query_specs.title: Owner score volatility

query_specs.description: Hidden score movement for a single bundle over time, grouped by month. This is the quickest way to confirm whether a bundle is decaying quietly.
query_specs.sql:
select
  bundle_id,
  substr(started_at, 1, 7) as month_bucket,
  round(avg(hidden_percent), 2) as average_hidden_percent,
  round(avg(percent), 2) as average_percent
from history_import
where bundle_id = :bundle_id
  and started_at >= :since
group by bundle_id, month_bucket
order by month_bucket desc
query_specs.title: Bundle hidden drift

query_specs.description: Cross-owner view of review states, intended for staffing and handoff conversations.
query_specs.sql:
select
  owner,
  json_extract(payload_json, '$.review_state') as review_state,
  count(*) as row_count
from history_import
where started_at >= :since
group by owner, review_state
order by review_state, owner
query_specs.title: Review state owner matrix

query_specs.description: Correlates queue latency with score band for each owner. Useful when a release train slowed down and the team wants to know whether quality or capacity drove it.
query_specs.sql:
select
  owner,
  band,
  round(avg(json_extract(payload_json, '$.queue_latency_ms')), 2) as average_queue_latency_ms,
  count(*) as row_count
from history_import
where started_at >= :since
group by owner, band
order by owner, band
query_specs.title: Owner band latency cross
